title: A Alibi for the Verdict
author: Paloma Whitlock
blurb: August Pemberton, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, has spent seven years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the town's beloved founder is exhumed and the coffin is empty, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must untangle alibis woven thirty years ago before the statute expires.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
